name: MELTDOWN
about: The C example MELTDOWN rebuilt in blocks: ten captive ball hits light a 3-ball multiball where the core heats by itself and with every jackpot (x1 to x5), the shields cool it, and at 100% the Building is a super jackpot worth twice the jackpots paid.
lost: No randomness in blocks: the HEART starts at the Left ramp and moves in turn (Left ramp, Right ramp, Building, Big loop) every 8 s and when hit, where the C picked another shot at random.
The core is looked at once a second (an Every second script), so it rises a whole 1% or 2% each second and the MELTDOWN blink quickens on the second, where the C stepped them every tick.

No timer badge: the MELTDOWN 20 s is a timer the line counts (SUPER JACKPOT AT THE BUILDING: 17), where the C counted it on the MELTDOWN badge (a blocks badge counts only the mode's own clock, and this mode has none).

The HUD shows the core as a number (25), not 25%; the JACKPOTS counter has no SUPER value under it; the CORE gauge is one colour (the C's ran yellow to white-hot); the lines lost their double spaces to fit the 40 letters a blocks HUD line holds.

The ending's line under MELTDOWN TOTAL puts the jackpots last (1 MELTDOWN SURVIVED  -  JACKPOTS 6) where the C said 6 JACKPOTS  -  1 MELTDOWN SURVIVED, says JACKPOTS for one too, and past 3 meltdowns says only the jackpots.
The ending stays up 3 s, the runtime's: the C kept it 10 s.
The captive ball counts toward lighting it while another of our modes runs, where the C left the shot to that mode.
The ready light is the runtime's lit mode (held ball after ball), where the C pulsed MAGNA GRAB only while nothing else owned the playfield.
One ball left is checked once a second after 18 s (two looks in a row), the C's 2 s after the 15 s ball save and 3 s grace; and the C noted whether a second ball was ever served.
Godzilla LE only: the program names the center shield target (Godzilla Pro has two shields).

hud.line: SHOOT RED SHOTS - SHIELDS COOL THE CORE

do.sub: HIS HEART IS A NUCLEAR REACTOR

then.sub: SHOOT THE SHIELDS TO COOL HIM

then.text: SHIELDS COOL THE CORE - OR RIDE THE HEAT

else.text: SHOOT RED SHOTS - THE HEART PAYS DOUBLE

intro.what: Burning Godzilla in the dark, glowing red, steam pouring off him (one shot)

loop.what: Night Tokyo: Burning Godzilla glows through steam, then a wide shot of him walking through the dark city, red-orange

jackpot.what: Godzilla fires the red spiral ray; it tears into Destoroyah's face

cool.what: The freezing beam hits Godzilla; he disappears in icy blue-white mist (one shot)

critical.what: Burning Godzilla in profile, red veins glowing, white-hot energy behind him (one shot)

meltdown.what: Godzilla melts down: his body dissolves into glowing red particles (one shot)

won.what: In the radiant mist the revived, grown Godzilla Junior rises as a silhouette and roars (one shot)

lost.what: Night: the city erupts in fireballs and burns (one shot)

music.what: Akira Ifukube's end-title march under the credits: the driving ostinato of the Godzilla theme (bed finder: final 0.821, loop chroma 0.835, 0 untuned blocks, beat-locked)

cool.what: the freezer beams hitting Godzilla, the white cloud bursting (1:36:35); 2.75 s, so MELTDOWN's five long calls each have a carrier as long

meltdown.what: the biggest blast of the final battle (1:35:29)
